title: MPSelectTune: Prompt-type Selection for Fine-tuning improves Concept Unlearning in LLMs

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the model's accuracy in predicting gender from the input (Concept Accuracy) and computing a generalized Spuriousness Score (SP-Score) to measure the model's reliance on spurious correlations between main task labels (e.g., profession, sentiment, toxicity) and gender.
